current.text: The projected starting five is Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe, Jaylen Brown, LeBron James and Joel Embiid.
Philadelphia added Jaylen Brown, LeBron James, Dean Wade, Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, Ariel Hukporti and Anfernee Simons. Paul George, Kelly Oubre, Quentin Grimes and Andre Drummond are gone.
Maxey, Embiid, LeBron and Brown will cut into each other's usage. Each star should get fewer shots than he would as a top option.
Brown and Maxey cannot both stay top five scorers on the same team.
The new stars cut into VJ Edgecombe's role.
New guards, including Anfernee Simons, should cut Maxey's minutes.
One expert expects more from Embiid this season.
Embiid missed big stretches of time last season.
Embiid is expected to miss games and LeBron to sit games. Brown's minutes and usage should rise when they are out.
One expert projects about 51 to 52 wins. He expects growing pains in October and November and load management for the stars.
Backup center and rebounding are the team's biggest weaknesses without Andre Drummond. Adem Bona is the backup center.
The team has 13 back-to-backs, the fewest in the league. That lowers rest risk for its stars on any single night.
In our fantasy playoffs (weeks 19 to 21) the team plays 11 games, rank 4 of 30. It has two back-to-backs in that span, in weeks 20 and 21. Week 19 has only 3 games.
The guard rotation is crowded and the rookie Labaron Philon sits behind Maxey and Edgecombe. That limits his value.

note: Philadelphia stacks four stars, so Maxey, Brown, Embiid and LeBron all lose usage, and Edgecombe, Simons and the rookie Philon have little room. Nurse's heavy minutes and the league's fewest back-to-backs help, but expect Embiid to miss games and LeBron to rest. When they sit, Brown gains the most. Watch early how the shots split, since experts expect growing pains in October and November, and check whether Adem Bona gets real backup center minutes.
